name: smwgraphics-super-mario-maker-styled-dry-bones
title: Super Mario Maker Styled Dry Bones
description:
This is an original dry bones sprite graphic for my upcoming hack, Super Mario Sandwich.

The SMW dry bones doesn't look good on a lighter background, this one does.
It has the shape of the SMW dry bones, but has the style of the SMM one!

It comes with SP4 sheet for custom sprites and Yoshi compatibility.
And of course, the standard SP3 and SP4 files.

I have been working on a few graphics that fit the Halloween season.
